title: Find All Groups of Farmland
summary: Given a 0-indexed m x n binary matrix land where 0s represent forested land and 1s represent farmland, identify and return the coordinates of each group of contiguous farmland.
statement: Given a 0-indexed m x n binary matrix land where 0s represent forested land and 1s represent farmland, identify and return the coordinates of each group of contiguous farmland. Each group forms a rectangle with no adjacent groups. The coordinates should be returned as 4-length arrays [r1, c1, r2, c2], where (r1, c1) is the top-left and (r2, c2) is the bottom-right corner of each group. Return an empty array if there are no groups of farmland.
constraints: land is a nonempty binary matrix with at most 300 rows and columns.
Each farmland group is a solid rectangle of ones, and distinct groups do not touch in four directions.
hints: Only a rectangle’s top-left cell has no farmland immediately above or left.
Scan row-major; at each top-left, extend down and right to find the opposite corner.
Skip zero or cells with a one above/left; measure the run downward and rightward.
The rectangle guarantee makes these runs its exact bounds, while the top-left predicate selects every group exactly once.
editorial: The rectangle guarantee makes these runs its exact bounds, while the top-left predicate selects every group exactly once.

tests.explanation: There is one single-cell group and one 2-by-2 rectangle.
All cells form the rectangle from zero,zero through one,one.
